tha-ap355:1.1: samattaṃ. [350. Kiṃsukapūjaka.] Kiṃsukaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā paggahetvāna añjaliṃ / Buddhaṃ saritvā Siddhattham ākāse abhipūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap355:2.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap355:4.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Kiṃsukapūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
